thread:
Maya (Marketing): Hey runtime — we need a tiny, focused sanity sweep for the webinar next Wed. Not a full repro but a mini smoke run we can cite on slides. Can you run the candidate model variants (base + quantized int8) against the demo payloads and confirm tail p99 latency and coldstart heatmap?

Sam (Runtime): Sure. Quick Qs: which model(s) exactly and which payload set? small demo set or the full benchpack?

Maya (Marketing): Use the demo cohort attached in the Google drive (shared earlier) — ~50 sessions, mixed long/short. Models: redwood-alpha-v2 and redwood-alpha-v2-int8. We mainly need: mean token/sec, p50/p95/p99, and a coldstart heatmap (first 1, 5, 10 minutes). Deadline EOD Monday if possible.

Priya (EngRuntime): Got it. We'll do a 2-run sweep: cold (no warmup) and warm (standard warmup). Do you want warmup pattern algo? We usually run: 10 synthetic warmups + 30 real demo warmups.

Maya (Marketing): Yes please follow the standard warmup (10 synthetic + 30 real). Also include sample generated snippets for parity check — just copy 5 short outputs per variant.

Jordan (Perf): I'll capture kernel-level counters and batch size distribution. Also suggest we log kv-cache hit stats (if applicable) so we can note cache benefit on slides.

Sam (Runtime): Plan: run 3 iterations per variant (cold/warm), collect metrics, produce a concise artifact bundle: metrics.csv, heatmaps.png, sample_outputs.zip, run-config.txt. We will also include the warmup script snippet.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Small ask: can you put one-line caveats for each artifact (e.g., "quantized run had 2% quality divergence on short prompts") if you see anything surprising?

Priya (EngRuntime): We'll do quick eval on the 5 sample outputs vs baseline and add a one-line note. If divergence >3% we'll flag for deeper evaluation.

Sam (Runtime): Starting queue now. ETA Monday EOD. Posting run command here for transparency:

```
# smoke run (example)
redwood-run --model redwood-alpha-v2 --payload demo_cohort.json --runs 3 --warmup-pattern "10syn+30real" --collect-kernel-stats --output /tmp/webinar-smoke/alpha-v2
redwood-run --model redwood-alpha-v2-int8 --payload demo_cohort.json --runs 3 --warmup-pattern "10syn+30real" --quantize int8 --output /tmp/webinar-smoke/alpha-v2-int8
```

Maya (Marketing): Thanks — can you drop artifacts into the shared S3 path when done and ping here? Link: s3://redwood-marketing/webinar-2026/smoke-artifacts/

deploy-bot: New run queued: job-id r-20260301-89a2. Notifying eng-runtime cluster.

Sam (Runtime): Quick note — if we see cold p99 > 2.5s for int8 on the long-tail prompts we'll try toggling batch_timeout to 25ms and re-run one pass. Will document any changes.

Elena (Product): Adding: please include the per-route token cost estimate for the demo (rough order of magnitude). Marketing will map to pricing blurb.

Priya (EngRuntime): Acknowledged. We'll include token counts and cost estimates using current pricing snapshot.

Maya (Marketing): Appreciate it. If anything blocks the Monday window call it out now so we can prioritize.

Sam (Runtime): If the quantized binary fails on one node we'll fall back to mixed-precision variant and note that in the caveats. Otherwise smooth. Will update with the S3 link when complete.

Maya (Marketing): Awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:

[-- thread archived for posterity once artifacts uploaded --]
